name: bereavement-support
description:
Produces structured logistics frameworks for the immediate aftermath of
a death and ongoing practical support for the bereaved, covering notification
lists, arrangement decisions, document collection, estate tasks, and
long-term administrative transitions. Focuses on the practical steps and
organizational tasks, not grief therapy or emotional processing.
Use when the user asks about what to do after someone dies, managing
the logistics after a death, or organizing practical support for a
bereaved person.
Do NOT use for grief counseling, emotional processing of loss, or
estate legal advice (consult an attorney for probate).
